Photopea

Alternative to Photoshop · Image editing
Freemium Web

Photopea is a browser-based image editor with an interface familiar to Photoshop users. It supports PSD files, layers, masks, filters, vectors, and many common editing workflows without installation. The free version is surprisingly capable, making it useful for quick edits and for users who need Photoshop-style functionality without Creative Cloud.

GIMP

Alternative to Photoshop · Image editing
Free Windows, macOS, Linux

GIMP is a long-running open-source image editor with layers, selections, masks, brushes, filters, and extensive customization. It takes more time to learn than simpler web editors, but it offers serious desktop editing without a subscription. Plugins and community documentation make it a flexible option for photographers, designers, and artists.
